QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper insists that you return to where your adventure began to find the lost memory. You can radio Gen at the hideout for a bit of help.
QuestInfo.1: Gen said you were a weakling when you joined up, but he seems almost... proud of the progress you've made since you last spoke. It's awfully sentimental for such a no-nonsense outlaw.
